wiperstoggle.title: Toggle Windshield Wipers
wiperstoggle.desc: Toggles between the speed of the windshield wipers or switches them off.

wipersdown.title: Decrease Windshield Wipers
wipersdown.desc: Decreases the speed of the windshield wipers or turns them off.

wipersup.title: Increase Windshield Wipers
wipersup.desc: Increase the speed of the windshield wipers or switches them on.

interiorlighttoggle.title: Interior Light
interiorlighttoggle.desc: Toggles the interior light between always on and open door only.

seatFLtoggle.title: Toogle Front Left Seat
seatFLtoggle.desc: Moves the front left seat forward and backwards.

seatFRtoggle.title: Toogle Front Right Seat
seatFRtoggle.desc: Moves the front right seat forward and backwards.

switchboardBtnToggle_Beacon.title: Toogle Beacon Light
switchboardBtnToggle_Beacon.desc: Toggles the beacon light on or off.

switchboardBtnToggle_Siren.title: Toogle Siren
switchboardBtnToggle_Siren.desc: Toggle the siren on or off.

switchboardBtnToggle_Extlight.title: Toogle Exterior Light
switchboardBtnToggle_Extlight.desc: Toggle exterior lights on or off.

switchboardBtnToggle_Underglown.title: Toogle Underglown
switchboardBtnToggle_Underglown.desc: Toggle the underglown on or off.

doorventFLopen.title: Vent Window Left Open
doorventFLopen.desc: Opens the front left vent window.

doorventFLclose.title: Vent Window Left Close
doorventFLclose.desc: Closes the front left vent window.

doorventFRopen.title: Vent Window Right Open
doorventFRopen.desc: Opens the front right vent window.

doorventFRclose.title: Vent Window Right Close
doorventFRclose.desc: Closes the front right vent window.

togglegascap.title: Toggle Rally Gas Cap
togglegascap.desc: Open and closed the rally gas cap.

togglefuelcap.title: Toggle Fuel Cap
togglefuelcap.desc: Open and closed the fuel cap.

batteryinfo.title: Display Battery Status
batteryinfo.desc: Displays the current charge and remaining time of the battery.

hoodCatch.title: Hood Catch
hoodCatch.desc: Open the hood when the hood latach was released.
